presentation.label: MAIN RMS
presentation.summary: On the compressor pages, the VOL label draws inverted while the main output is louder than -18 dBFS RMS, for gain staging.
presentation.overview: Main RMS lights the VOL knob's label on the compressor pages while the main output is louder than -18 dBFS RMS. The level is the louder of MAIN L and R, each a mean square averaged over about 300 ms; the label turns on above the threshold and off again 1 dB below it. MAIN is read each audio block from the pair USB and the sampler record, after the compressor. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0009-main-rms, with his code unchanged.
highlights: VOL lights while the main output is over -18 dBFS RMS.
Louder of left and right, about 300 ms average, 1 dB hysteresis.
Display only: the sound is unchanged.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Main RMS. Select the FX track and open its AMP page, the compressor.
Play a loud pattern: the VOL label draws inverted while the main output is over -18 dBFS RMS.
Turn the pattern down or mute tracks: the label clears once the level falls 1 dB below the threshold.

access.location: FX track, AMP page (the compressor): the VOL knob's label.
steps: Select the FX track and open its AMP page.
Play: the VOL label inverts while the output is loud.

controls.name: Knob VOL (compressor)
controls.doc: Unchanged control. Its label draws inverted while the main output is over -18 dBFS RMS.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
The threshold is fixed at -18 dBFS RMS, the default build's value.
The master volume knob does not set the measured pair, though the circuit can move it by a few dB over the knob's travel.
A label stock has already highlighted reads normal while over, because the inversion is an XOR.

load.display: Small: one 32-frame scan of MAIN L and R per audio block
load.conditions: Static: the detour in the audio block (about 1,500 blocks a second) reads 32 frames of MAIN L and R and updates two running mean squares; the two draw wrappers run only when the compressor view draws VOL. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, main-rms 1.0 passed its test (FX track AMP page: playing a loud pattern inverts the VOL label, which clears when the output gets quieter) in R8T2 (2026-10-18), and its own test again with core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports in C3A4 (2026-10-20). On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24/25) VOL stayed plain while the main output stayed below the threshold, and with the main output at -3.4 dBFS RMS VOL inverted while playing and cleared about 4 s after STOP. Alone on MRH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) VOL inverted with the main output above the threshold and cleared within 4.4 s of stop.
limitations: Tested builds: C3A4, .syx 04d987ced36850eef5eb5cd1215d411edf621a5af94f980525ab561c9108f951; R8T2, .syx 94c8b8c4f3f537132b7ee689ad1221591186f14dc605a420cdefe3df804e3c39. Firmware was not read back from the device.

SXH4 (the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-24/25, .syx e4d01a6aec250bd2af7743c9f8b0e9c560d805b52564932dddc41d872e1c5000) also carried a remote-control test layer that shares no site with core or the modules. MRH4 (alone with the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-25, .syx f3e304ea7454cd1b53801b19cb92b9e71add055bd26e430219328dc56b05606a) carried the same test layer.

tests.summary: Hardware: main-rms 1.0's test passes on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74 (R8T2 with core-ar2 0.1, 2026-10-18; C3A4 with core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-20). Modwerk's source build gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.2 release. In rytm-emu the compressor page draws as on stock while quiet; the emulator's main output never gets loud enough to light the label.
